# Static builds rewrite root-absolute links to pages in the tree, as
# written for a hosted docs site, so the output works under any prefix.

md2html -html out .
grep 'href="foo.html#setup"' out/docs/bar.html
grep 'href="\.\./foo.html"' out/docs/sub/x.html
grep 'href="/docs/missing"' out/docs/bar.html
grep 'href="https://example.com/docs/foo"' out/docs/bar.html

# Raw HTML links are rewritten too.
rm -rf out
md2html -allow-unsafe -html out .
grep 'href="\.\./foo.html"' out/docs/sub/x.html

# Building docs/ alone resolves against the docs.json directory.
cd docs
md2html -html ../out2 .
grep 'href="foo.html#setup"' ../out2/bar.html

-- docs.json --
{"name": "example", "navigation": {"pages": ["docs/foo", "docs/bar"]}}
-- docs/foo.md --
# Foo

## Setup
-- docs/bar.md --
# Bar

See [setup](/docs/foo#setup), [missing](/docs/missing),
and [elsewhere](https://example.com/docs/foo).
-- docs/sub/x.md --
# X

Back to [foo](/docs/foo).

<div><a href="/docs/foo">Foo</a></div>
